title: Cycle workload bucketing and contingent staffing simulator
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Problem statement: during cycle planning we repeatedly under- or over-allocate people across different work rhythms (steady product work, short high-latency spikes like incidents or carrier integrations, and long opaque R&D investigations). That mismatch drives mid-cycle scope churn and emergency reassignments.

Proposal: build a compact 'contingent staffing simulator' + playbook that 1) buckets recurring workload into a small taxonomy (steady throughput, predictable spikes, maintenance ops, exploration), 2) models staffing profiles (core fraction, shadow rotation, reserve pool), and 3) outputs recommended contingent staffing schedules and de-scope triggers for a target cycle. The deliverable is an MVP simulator (not production-grade), a one-page decision canvas for PMs/ENG leads, and a short playbook for after-hours/incident shadow coverage.

Why this helps: gives an evidence-backed, repeatable method for setting soft staffing reserves and defensible scope cuts; reduces mid-cycle firefights; and provides inputs for Dedicated & Private capacity planning analogs (how much safety buffer to reserve for production reliability work).
acceptance_criteria: MVP simulator that accepts historical workload traces (CSV) and outputs recommended reserve FTE and shadow rotation schedule for a 6-week and 12-week horizon
At least 20 randomized scenario runs demonstrating sensitivity to spike frequency and investigator ticket size (documented results)
One-page decision canvas (PDF) describing recommended contingent staffing bands and clear de-scope triggers
Playbook (Confluence) with runbook steps for triggering reserve pool and communicating scope cuts to stakeholders
Walkthrough/QA session scheduled with Eng Leads and EMs; presentation notes captured and next actions assigned
tasks: Define workload buckets and canonical ticket sizes (steady, spike, maintenance, research)
Instrument/transform historical linear ticket exports and time-tracking into simulator CSVs (ENG help required)
Prototype simulator in a Colab/Python notebook (randomized scenario engine + simple monte-carlo)
Run baseline scenarios and produce a 2-page results memo
Draft decision canvas and playbook; circulate for stakeholder feedback
Schedule review with Eng Leads, Design PM, and Solutions (target: 2026-03-18)
Publish final artifacts to Confluence and link from cycle planning template
